title: Hormuz blockade persists, why India’s Russian oil import is down from highs seen in March

description: Delhi High Court rejected Arvind Kejriwal's plea to recuse Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma from the excise policy case, citing lack of evidence for bias claims. Kejriwal and Manish Sisodia have now refused to appear before the judge, escalating the legal and political standoff. The court warned against forum shopping and undermining judicial independence.

author: NARESH CHANDRA PATTANAYAK
description: A tribal man in Keonjhar exhumed his deceased sister's skeleton and brought it to a rural bank to claim her deposited money. Bank officials, frightened by the sight, alerted the police. After police intervention and explanation, the man, unable to provide a death certificate due to illiteracy, eventually reburied his sister's remains.
title: Odisha man digs up sister’s skeleton, protests outside bank to claim Rs 19,300

author: LACHIT ROY
description: The latest Luka Doncic injury update points to steady progress as he resumes on-court movement following a hamstring strain. While coach JJ Redick remains cautious, medical insight suggests a possible return in early May. Doncic is expected to miss the rest of the first-round series against the Rockets, where the Lakers hold a 3-1 lead. Game 5 brings fresh lineup shifts, with Austin Reaves set to return and Kevin Durant ruled out, shaping a pivotal playoff moment.
title: Luka Doncic injury update: Doctor reveals return timeline for Lakers star

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Candace Owens has sparked online speculation after canceling her show again, with a viral post questioning her whereabouts during the White House Correspondents Dinner incident and suggesting a possible link to Cole Allen. No verified evidence supports these claims, but her silence has fueled debate, highlighting how quickly unconfirmed narratives can spread across social media.
title: Where is Candace Owens? Show cancelled amid WHCD and Cole Allen buzz

author: SEHJAL GUPTA
description: Fred Liu, Evelyn Ha’s ex-boyfriend, has supported parts of Ben Pasternak’s abuse claims after his arrest in New York. Pasternak denies all charges and says Ha was the aggressor. Liu shared that his past experience felt similar but stayed silent earlier. The case includes serious assault charges and is ongoing, with court proceedings expected on June 11.
title: Fred Liu - Evelyn Ha’s ex backs Ben Pasternak, alleges abuse details

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Cybercriminals are now leveraging Microsoft Teams, posing as IT helpdesk staff, to trick employees into revealing credentials and installing malware. Google warns this new tactic involves overwhelming users with spam emails before offering fake technical assistance via Teams. Victims click malicious links, leading to credential theft and the deployment of sophisticated malware for persistent access.
title: Google issues new 'warning' in Microsoft Teams chat invitations and helpdesk scam

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: At an NRAI event in Delhi, Manu Bhaker was asked about Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, sparking online criticism for shifting focus from her Olympic achievements. Bhaker emphasized mentorship, saying age doesn’t limit talent. Social media, including Joy Bhattacharjya, called the question unfair and cricket-centric. Meanwhile, Sooryavanshi continues to shine, becoming the youngest to 1,000 T20 runs and emerging as a promising future star for India.
title: Internet fumes after Manu Bhaker asked about Vaibhav Sooryavanshi

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's sister, Annie Altman, faces a setback as both her law firms withdraw from her sexual abuse lawsuit against him. Citing a breakdown in their relationship, the firms cited 'impracticable' circumstances. Annie accuses Sam of abuse from childhood, while he denies the claims and countersues for defamation, alleging extortion.
title: Law firms representing Sam Altman's sister withdraw from lawsuit against OpenAI CEO

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Virat Kohli became the first batter to cross 9,000 IPL runs, further cementing his legacy of consistency and dominance. Irfan Pathan said the milestone is “just a stepping stone” for Kohli. At Arun Jaitley Stadium, Kohli played an unbeaten, match-winning knock. With eight centuries, strong form, and Orange Cap contention, he remains central to RCB’s success this season and their strong playoff push.
title: 'If anyone can challenge Virat, it's ... ': Kohli's record called 'stepping stone'

author: TNN
description: Maharashtra minister Nitesh Rane received a one-month jail sentence for pouring mud on an NHAI engineer in 2019. The court, while acquitting 29 others, found Rane guilty of intentional insult, emphasizing lawmakers shouldn't take the law into their own hands. His sentence was later suspended for appeal.
title: Maharashtra minister Nitesh Rane awarded 1-mth jail for 2019 mud attack on NHAI engineer

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Dhurandhar 2 experienced a major box office drop on its 40th day. The film earned Rs 1.05 crore in India and Rs 0.25 crore overseas. Its worldwide gross collection reached Rs 1779.02 crore. Competitors Bhooth Bangla and Michael also saw reduced earnings on Monday. The movie's performance reflects a decline after its initial surge.
title: ‘Dhurandhar 2’ misses Rs 1780 crore mark worldwide by whisker

author: TNN
description: India's largest pharma company, Sun Pharma, has made its biggest overseas acquisition, buying Organon & Co for $11.8 billion. This deal significantly expands Sun Pharma's global presence and product range. It will double the company's revenue and EBITDA. The acquisition positions Sun Pharma as a major player in women's health and biosimilars. This strategic move strengthens Sun Pharma's position in the global pharmaceutical market.
title: Sun Pharma buys US-based Organon for $12 billion in biggest-ever overseas pharma deal
